# Hydro dMRV

> Digital measurement, reporting and verification (dMRV) for run-of-river hydropower on Hedera. A deterministic
> 5-layer engine verifies metered telemetry; approved reports are anchored on the Hedera Consensus Service (HCS);
> the HydroREC contract mints Hedera Token Service RECs (1 token = 1 MWh, 1 base unit = 1 kWh) and sells them at
> USD prices settled in HBAR through a Chainlink HBAR/USD feed. Retiring burns the tokens.

Everything below is relative to this site's origin. Read-only access needs no credentials.

## MCP (recommended for agents)

- Endpoint: `/api/mcp` (streamable HTTP, stateless; MCP 2025-06-18 and 2026-07-28)
- Tools: `list_scenarios`, `generate_sample_telemetry`, `verify_telemetry`, `get_registry_overview`,
  `list_attestations`, `audit_attestation`, `list_open_listings`
- Write tool `submit_attestation` is listed only when the request carries `Authorization: Bearer <MRV_API_KEY>`
- Resource: `hydro-dmrv://methodology` (verification rules in Markdown)

## REST

- `GET  /api/mrv/scenarios` — sample scenarios and the demo plant profile
- `GET  /api/mrv/scenarios/{healthy|inflated|replay|spikes|polluted}?hours=24` — deterministic readings
- `POST /api/mrv/verify` — body `{ "readings": Reading[], "plant"?: PlantProfile }` → report, HCS message, reportHash
- `GET  /api/registry` — on-chain totals, plants, REC token, Chainlink HBAR/USD price
- `GET  /api/registry/attestations?start=0&count=20` — attestations with HCS anchors
- `GET  /api/registry/attestations/{id}/audit` — mirror-node proof that an attestation matches its HCS report
- `GET  /api/registry/listings` — open listings with HBAR quotes (tinybar)
- `POST /api/mrv/attest` — verify → HCS → mint; requires `Authorization: Bearer <MRV_API_KEY>`

## Data shapes

- Reading: `{ timestamp (ISO 8601, end of interval), intervalMinutes, flowRateM3s, headM, energyKwh,
  efficiency?, ph?, turbidityNtu?, temperatureC? }`
- Decision: APPROVED (trust ≥ 0.90 and no failed interval), FLAGGED (trust ≥ 0.50), else REJECTED.
  Replayed timestamps, energy above nameplate capacity or >20% of intervals failing physics are always REJECTED.

## Source

- Contracts: `packages/hardhat/contracts/HydroREC.sol`
- Engine: `packages/nextjs/services/mrv/engine.ts`
- Agent briefing for coding agents: `AGENTS.md`
